_comment: Synthetic calibration set for the automatic-incident overlap policy (owner directive D-1, NORMAS_BACKLOG.md section 7). Each case: the OPEN tickets, the incoming incident, and the tier it must get. 'never_high' cases are the false-merge guard: a HIGH there would append an unrelated defect to a ticket. A new auto-reporting component or error/log format needs a case here (tests/test_backlog_overlap.py::test_every_incident_reporter_has_a_fixture_case enforces it).
